versions.content: On reception of an OBD Service $06 request with only "availability OBDMID(s)" as parameter(s), the Dcm module shall obtain the supported OBDMIDs by calling the Dem interface Dem_DcmGetAvailableOBDMIDs()for each "availability OBD- MID ($00, $20, ...)" contained within the request and concatenate the results within the response message according to ISO-15031-5 [2].
